shortDescription: Manages VLAN resources and attributes on Huawei CloudEngine switches.

options.name: description
options.description: Specify VLAN description, minimum of 1 character, maximum of 80 characters.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of VLAN, minimum of 1 character, maximum of 31 characters.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage the state of the resource.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: Single VLAN ID, in the range from 1 to 4094.

options.name: vlan_range
options.description: Range of VLANs such as C(2-10) or C(2,5,10-15), etc.
